business_summary: China Vered Financial Holding Corporation Limited, an investment holding company, provides asset management, consultancy, financing, and securities advisory and brokerage services in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, and Japan. The company is involved in money lending services. The company was formerly known as China Minsheng Financial Holding Corporation Limited and changed its name to China Vered Financial Holding Corporation Limited in July 2020. China Vered Financial Holding Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Wong Chuk Hang, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 China Vered Financial Holding Corporation Limited는 홍콩, 중국 및 일본에서 자산 관리, 컨설팅, 금융, 증권 자문 및 중개 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사는 자금 대출 서비스에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 China Minsheng Financial Holding Corporation Limited로 알려졌으나 2020년 7월에 China Vered Financial Holding Corporation Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. China Vered Financial Holding Corporation Limited는 1972년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 Wong Chuk Hang에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
